pr_title: Add support for OpenWeatherMap One Call API
pr_body:
<!--

## Breaking change
Removed YAML support for OpenWeatherMap. Existing users should set up their integration using the config flow in the UI.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

Added support for OpenWeatherMap's One Call API, meaning that weather and forecast can be retrieved with a single request. This has the following benefits:
- More frequent updates are possible using the free tier
- Free tier daily forecast now also contains highs and lows, and not just one temperature

issue_context.title: OpenWeatherMap shows daily morning weather
issue_context.body: ## The problem When using the integration with the `freedaily` mode, the Weather card shows the **morning** weather at 8:00, instead of the **day** weather. For example, the temperatures are always much too low compared to other weather integrations. **Dark Sky** **OpenWeatherMap** OpenWeatherMap (attributes) ## Environment - Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.110.3 - Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): ? - Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Home Assistant - Integration causing this issue: OpenWeatherMap - Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/openweathermap/ ## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml` ```yaml weather: - platform: openweathermap api_key: !secret openweathermap_api_key mode: freedaily ``` ## Traceback/Error logs ```txt ``` ## Additional information The One Call API has daily forecasts for multiple times of the day: https://openweathermap.org/api/one-call-api I think the integration currently uses the `daily.temp.morn` but should use `daily.temp.day`. I haven't been able to find this in the integration code, so it might as well be a bug in the OWM library. https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/fbe7b4ddfa813e300f99175d254ec509c8d65e33/homeassistant/components/openweathermap/weather.py#L5
